readme.text:
[](https://github.com/xuzhecomeon/dsh-research-suite/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-research-suite)
[](LICENSE)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for the full clinical-research workflow — manuscript writing, language polishing, figures, statistics, research ideation, peer review, slides, literature search and journal formatting. Install it and it **takes over research tasks automatically**: no UI, no manual skill picking.

> 中文完整说明见 **[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)**（内容更全，含配置项、目录结构、占位符清单）。

- Package: `dsh-research-suite` · Version: `3.0.0` · License: MIT
- Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, DSH `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0`
- **Self-contained: all 592 source skill documents plus their bundled `references/scripts/templates` assets ship inside the package; nothing is read from any external skill directory at runtime.**

readme.section: Why capability cards instead of a skill router
readme.text: The hard part of research work is not a lack of skills — it is that three to eight skills can each do the same task well in different ways. A router hands the model one "primary skill" name; the model then reads that skill's manual and improvises, losing the other skills' strengths along the way.

readme.section: Why capability cards instead of a skill router
readme.text: Instead, each **capability card** takes every competing skill in its group, records `best_at` (what it is best at), `limits` (what it explicitly cannot do) and `take` (the concrete rules, thresholds and templates lifted from it), then fuses them into one executable **protocol**. Every protocol step says which skill it comes from and why. The acceptance rule is strict: *after reading one capability card you can finish the job without opening any original skill document.*

readme.section: Why capability cards instead of a skill router
readme.text: The 592 source documents (and the 3,924 asset files they bring along) remain bundled as a deep-reading layer — for checking details, not for improvising.

1. **A system-prompt section** — `lib/prompt.js` builds a policy named `research-suite/policy` at `order: 650` ("after team policy, before tool docs"); `lib/index.js` registers it through `systemPrompt.section({ name, order, text: () => buildPolicy(core) })`. The policy tells the model: recognise a research task → call `research_playbook` first → follow the capability protocol → deep-read if needed → run `research_gate` before delivering.
2. **11 skills** (`skills/`): one entry skill plus ten domain SOPs (writing / polish / figures / stats / ideation / review / slides / literature / format / data). Their `content` is inlined **at registration time** — passing a lazy `load()` hook fails DSH's runtime validation and silently drops every skill (the exact failure mode of v1).
3. **7 read-only tools** for capability lookup, searching the 592-document catalog, deep reading (including skill-bundled assets), standards, and mechanical self-checks.
When `research_playbook` finds no match, the policy falls back to `research_catalog` + `research_kb_read` rather than refusing the task.

| Domain | Source skills | Covers |
|---|---:|---|
| `writing` | 66 | paper types and sections (original / review / case report / grant) |
| `polish` | 12 | register, de-AI-flavour, reduction, proofreading, Word reports |
| `figures` | 36 | data plots, statistical charts, mechanism diagrams, layout |
| `stats` | 31 | descriptive, comparison, regression, survival, prediction, PSM, MR, Meta, missing data, sample size |
| `ideation` | 39 | topic selection, novelty search, hypotheses, grants, ethics |
| `review` | 21 | self-review, reviewer comments, revision, rebuttal, response letters |
| `slides` | 37 | conference, lecture, defence, lab meeting, poster |
| `literature` | 26 | search strings, screening, close reading, evidence tables, recall/precision |
| `format` | 51 | journal formatting, references, figure/table specs, submission package |
| `data` | 40 | databases and omics data: GEO / TCGA / dbGaP / genotype and variant databases, omics retrieval and curation |
| **Total** | **592** | **103** capability cards across the ten domains |

`toolbox` is an additional index-only bucket of 233 utility skills: it feeds `research_catalog` and `research_kb_read`, and deliberately has **no capability cards** — a tool is a means, not a task a user asks for.

Every one of the 592 source skills has a recorded verdict in `data/ledger/<domain>.json` (`fused` — and which cards it feeds / `index-only` / `deprecated` / `out-of-scope`), so the "all studied, best only" claim is auditable: `node scripts/verify-ledger.mjs all` re-checks coverage and that every `fused` skill is actually a member of the card it claims. Beyond the text, **skill-bundled assets ship too**: 451 skills contribute 3,924 files (~29 MB) of `references/`, `scripts/` and `templates/` under `knowledge/skills/<domain>/<slug>__assets/`; `research_kb_read(name, asset='scripts/plot.py')` reads them (omitting `asset` lists what the skill ships with). Nine reference standards live in `references/`.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `research_playbook` | **The only entry point.** Pass the user's own words; returns the 1–3 best-matching capability cards with protocol, gates, deliverables and suggested deep reads |
| `research_capability` | Expand a full capability card (member comparison, protocol, decisions, gates, outputs, kb) by `id` or by `domain` |
| `research_catalog` | Search the 592-document catalog by name/description keywords (the 233 `toolbox` skills included), optionally filtered by domain; each hit reports how many bundled assets it carries |
| `research_kb_read` | Read one skill document or `INDEX.md`/`FUSION.md`; the `asset` parameter reads a skill-bundled file such as `scripts/plot.py` or `references/*.md` (omitting it lists the skill's assets); paging and path-escape rejection included |
| `research_standard` | List or read the nine reference standards in `references/` |
| `research_gate` | Gate and mechanical self-check: `section` = `all` / `data` / `selfcheck` / `mutex` / `forbidden` / `hard` / `handoffs`; `text` checks fullwidth punctuation, superscript citation numbers, AI-cliché phrases and absolute wording |
| `research_suite_status` | Load self-check: versi
```powershell
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="<absolute package path or dsh-research-suite@3.0.0>")
dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add <absolute package path or package name>

dsh plugin --profile desktop add <absolute package path or package name>
```

Fully quit and restart DSH Desktop afterwards (closing the window is not enough — the loader reads the bundle patch layer at startup). Verify with `research_suite_status`.

The plugin deliberately **does not export a `Config`**: in v2.0.0 that export (`toJSON()` returning JSON Schema) was hydrated by DSH's Host settings service as a schemastery envelope, crashed on `schema.meta`, and prevented DSH Desktop from starting. Configuration is now validated inside `apply()` by `validateConfig()`.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `autoTakeover` | `true` | Inject the auto-takeover prompt section; `false` degrades the plugin to "7 tools + 11 skills" without automatic routing |
| `sectionOrder` | `650` | Order of the prompt section (after team policy, before tool docs) |
| `verbose` | `false` | Log warnings when skill/tool/prompt registration fails |

Because there is no exported `Config`, **the DSH settings panel shows no entries for this plugin** (a deliberate trade-off). Override values in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` entry instead:

```yaml
- id: dsh-research-suite
  config:
    autoTakeover: true
    sectionOrder: 650

```powershell
npm test                          # scripts/selftest.mjs — fake-ctx load smoke test
npm run verify                    # scripts/verify-package.mjs — static release checks
npm run verify:caps               # scripts/verify-capabilities.mjs all
node scripts/verify-ledger.mjs all # ledger coverage (11 domains, 592 skills) + fused check

Measured on the current v3 tree (final numbers follow once every domain lands): **4,577 files / 38.62 MB** on disk (`scripts/verify-package.mjs` count, includes `.github/`); the bulk is `knowledge/` — 592 source documents plus 3,924 bundled asset files.

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

**Scope note**: MIT covers the plugin itself (`lib/`, `data/`, `skills/`, `references/`, `scripts/`, `docs/` and the index files). The 592 skill texts and 3,924 bundled assets under `knowledge/skills/` are third-party material vendored verbatim from the author's local skill collection; their licenses belong to their original authors and are **not** covered by MIT. Read [docs/ATTRIBUTION.md](docs/ATTRIBUTION.md) before redistributing.

**一句话定位**：面向临床科研人员的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件——论文写作、润色、绘图、统计、科研思路、审稿、PPT、文献、格式全流程，装进 DSH 后**自动接管**科研任务，没有界面、不需要手动挑技能。

- 包名：`dsh-research-suite`　版本：`3.0.0`　许可证：MIT
- 运行环境：Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`，DSH `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0`
- **本插件自包含：592 个源技能全文 + 技能自带的 references/scripts/templates 资产随包分发，运行时不读取任何外部技能目录。**

科研任务的真实难点不是"缺技能"，而是"同一个任务有 3～8 个技能都能做，各有长处，到底用谁的哪一招"。

v1 的做法是认一个"首选技能"，然后让模型去读那份技能原文照做。三个问题：**机械单选丢掉别人的长处**（中文润色里"去文言腔"最强的、"字数守恒"最严的、"出 Word 精修报告"的往往不是同一个技能）；**选中不等于会用**（技能原文是给人读的说明书，动辄 8～25 KB，照读会漏判据、阈值、模板）；**责任又踢回模型**（给一串技能名，等于让模型自己想怎么组合）。

v2 的答案是**能力卡（capability）**：

> 一张能力卡 = 一件可独立验收的事（"给中文稿去 AI 味并保持字数"、"做倾向评分匹配并出 Love plot"）。
> 卡里把**所有**竞争技能拆成 `best_at`（最擅长的那一招）/ `limits`（明确不做什么）/ `take`（实际搬进协议的规则、阈值、模板），再合成为一条**融合协议**：每一步写清"取自谁、为什么取它、放弃了谁、为什么放弃"。
判据很硬：**读完一张能力卡，不打开任何原始技能原文，也能把这件事做完。** 原文保留在包内作为深读层，是"查细节"用的，不是"照做"用的。所以它**不是技能路由器**：返回的是已经组合好、带阈值和判据的协议，不是一份技能名清单。

readme.section: 自动接管是怎么实现的
readme.text:
1. **策略段注入**（`lib/prompt.js` + `lib/index.js`）：插件向 DSH 系统提示注入一段名为 `research-suite/policy`、`order: 650` 的策略（"团队策略之后、工具说明之前"），文本由 `buildPolicy(core)` 每次组装系统提示时现算。策略规定：识别到科研诉求 → **先调 `research_playbook`** → 按能力卡协议执行 → 需要细节再深读 → 交付前 `research_gate` 自检。
2. **11 个技能**（`skills/`）：1 个入口技能 + 10 个域融合 SOP（writing / polish / figures / stats / ideation / review / slides / literature / format / data），注册时**当场内联 `content` 字符串**（不能传 `load()` 之类惰性钩子，否则 DSH 加载期校验不过、技能全丢——这是 v1 的原始故障）。
3. **7 个只读工具**：给模型查询能力卡、检索 592 个源技能、读原文与自带资产、读规范、做机械自检的接口。

readme.section: 自动接管是怎么实现的
readme.text:
`research_playbook` 没命中时（任务超出覆盖范围），策略回退到 `research_catalog` 在 592 个源技能里检索再直读原文——**不拒答**。

技术细节见 [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) §五、§六。

| 域 | 源技能 | 覆盖什么 |
|---|---:|---|
| `writing` | 66 | 按论文类型与章节切分（原创/综述/病例报告/标书…） |
| `polish` | 12 | 语体、去 AI 味、降重、审校、Word 精修报告 |
| `figures` | 36 | 数据图、统计图、机制图、示意图、组合排版 |
| `stats` | 31 | 描述、比较、回归、生存、预测模型、PSM、MR、Meta、缺失、样本量 |
| `ideation` | 39 | 选题、查新、假说、标书、伦理 |
| `review` | 21 | 自审、审稿意见、修回、rebuttal、回复信 |
| `slides` | 37 | 汇报型、讲课型、答辩型、组会型、海报 |
| `literature` | 26 | 检索式、筛选、精读、证据表、查全查准 |
| `format` | 51 | 投稿格式、参考文献、图表规范、投稿包 |
| `data` | 40 | 数据库与组学数据：GEO / TCGA / dbGaP / 基因型与变异库检索、组学数据获取与整理 |
| **合计** | **592** | 10 个能力域共 **103** 张能力卡 |

另有 `toolbox` 域（233 个工具类技能的索引桶）：**只进 `research_catalog` 检索与 `research_kb_read` 深读，不产能力卡**——工具是手段，不是"用户要办的一件事"。

592 个源技能**全部逐条判定过**：每一条都在 `data/ledger/<domain>.json` 里留了判定（`fused` 融进哪张卡的哪一步 / `index-only` 仅编目 / `deprecated` 明确不用 / `out-of-scope` 不属于科研），理由可查，`node scripts/verify-ledger.mjs all` 机械核对覆盖度与"融进去了却不在卡里"。

除正文外，**技能自带资产随包**：451 个技能带来 3924 个文件（约 29 MB）的 `references/`、`scripts/`、`templates/`，放在 `knowledge/skills/<域>/<slug>__assets/`。模型可用 `research_kb_read(name, asset='scripts/plot.py')` 直接读这些资产（不给 `asset` 时列出该技能带了哪些资产）。

另有 9 份规范文档在 `references/`：中华医学会格式、中文语言风格与好句语料库、Elsevier 英文语言标准、论文类型风格档案、标书硬性规则与 AI 痕迹、IMA 知识库清单、IMA 知识库蒸馏任务书、科研技能索引、科研技能自动调用工作流。

| 工具 | 作用 | 调用方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `research_playbook` | **唯一入口**。传用户原话，返回最匹配的 1～3 张能力卡 + 融合协议 + 判据 + 交付物 + 建议深读 | 传 `task`（用户原话） |
| `research_capability` | 展开完整能力卡：成员对比表（best_at/limits/take）、protocol、decide、gates、outputs、kb | 按能力卡 `id` 或按 `domain` |
| `research_catalog` | 在 592 个源技能里检索（名称/描述关键词，可加域过滤；`toolbox` 的 233 个工具类技能也在内），每条附带它收了几个资产 | 传关键词，可选加域过滤 |
| `research_kb_read` | 读单个技能原文或 `INDEX.md`/`FUSION.md`；新增 `asset` 参数可读技能自带的 `scripts/plot.py`、`references/*.md` 等资产，不给 `asset` 时列出该技能附带哪些资产；支持分段，越界路径拒绝 | 传技能名，可选 `asset` / `offset` / `limit` |
| `research_standard` | 读 `references/` 下 9 份规范（列表或全文） | 传文件名；省略则列出 9 份 |
| `research_gate` | 门禁与机械自检：`section` 取 `all` / `data` / `selfcheck` / `mutex` / `forbidden` / `hard` / `handoffs`；`text` 检查标点、引用上标、AI 套话、绝对化措辞 | 传 `section` 或 `text` |
| `research_suite_status` | 装载自检：版本、10 域能力卡数量、592 索引完整性、资产收录统计、references 齐备性、包根路径 | 无参数 |

完整发布与排障看 [docs/PUBLISH.md](docs/PUBLISH.md)，这里只列最短路径。

**A. plugin_manager（GUI，推荐）**

```
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="<包的绝对目录>")
```

也可以从 npm 装：`target` 传 `dsh-research-suite@3.0.0`。

**B. CLI**

```powershell
dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add <包的绝对目录或包名>

dsh plugin --profile desktop add <包的绝对目录或包名>
```

装完**必须完全退出 DSH Desktop 再启动**（不是关窗口，是退出进程）——loader 只在启动时读补丁层 `cordis.patch.yml`。

验收：让模型调 `research_suite_status`，返回版本、10 域能力卡数量、592 索引完整性、资产收录统计、`references/` 齐备性、包根路径。7 个工具都在、技能计数正确，才算装好。

本插件**不对外导出 Config**：v2.0.0 上线当天就是因为导出了一个 `toJSON()` 返回 JSON Schema 的 Config，被 Host 的 settings 服务当作 schemastery 信封水合，`schema.meta` 为 `undefined`，读 `.volatile` 抛错，DSH Desktop 直接起不来。现在配置由 `apply()` 内的 `validateConfig()` 兜底校验，共 3 个键：

| 键 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `autoTakeover` | `true` | 是否注入「科研任务自动接管」策略段。设 `false` 后插件退化为"装了 7 个工具 + 11 个技能"，不再自动接管 |
| `sectionOrder` | `650` | 策略段在系统提示里的排序值。默认落在"团队策略之后、工具说明之前"；需要与其它插件抢位置时改它（合法区间 100–5000，非整数或越界会被配置校验拒绝） |
| `verbose` | `false` | `true` 时把注册/注入失败（技能注册失败、tools 服务缺失、systemPrompt 缺失）写成 warn 日志，排查期必开 |

因此 **DSH 的设置面板里暂时看不到本插件的配置项**（这是刻意取舍，不是遗漏）。要改配置，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给这个 entry 写 `config:`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-research-suite
  config:
    autoTakeover: true
    sectionOrder: 650

readme.section: 能力卡长什么样（节选，完整契约见 [docs/CAPABILITY-SPEC.md](docs/CAPABILITY-SPEC.md)）
readme.text:
```json
{
  "id": "polish.deai",
  "label": "中文去 AI 味与学术润色",
  "summary": "输入中文稿与目标期刊，输出保持字数的学术书面语版本 + 修改说明",

字段级硬约束（`id` 全局唯一、`members` 2～6 个、`triggers` 3～10 条、每条 `detail` ≥40 字、`gates` 必须可机械检查等）由 `scripts/verify-capabilities.mjs` 机械校验；技能名必须真在 `knowledge/catalog.json` 里，编造即报错。

```
dsh-research-suite/
├── package.json            # name/main/type/exports/engines/files + dsh.bundle.patch
├── cordis.patch.yml        # bundle 补丁层：- insert: id/name 两行
├── lib/                    # 运行时（只依赖 node 内置模块）

```powershell
npm test                          # node scripts/selftest.mjs（假 ctx 加载期 smoke test）
npm run verify                    # node scripts/verify-package.mjs（发布静态校验）
npm run verify:caps               # node scripts/verify-capabilities.mjs all（能力卡契约）
node scripts/verify-ledger.mjs all  # 判定账本（11 域 592 条覆盖 + fused 可核）

四条校验都必须 exit 0；CI（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）在 ubuntu-latest + Node 24 上跑同一套（verify-package → verify-capabilities → verify-ledger → selftest），并额外跑 `npm pack --dry-run`。`publish` job 默认**只能手动触发**（`workflow_dispatch`）：仓库还没配 secret `NPM_TOKEN` 时，打 tag 自动发布会以 401 失败并刷红 Actions，所以 tag 不会触发发布。要恢复「打 `v*` tag 即发 npm」，先在仓库 Settings → Secrets 配好 `NPM_TOKEN`，再把 `publish` job 的 `if` 改回 `startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'`（需 `id-token: write`，不写任何明文）。
当前包体（v3 中间态实测，全部域交付后以重跑为准）：**4577 个文件、38.62 MB**（`scripts/verify-package.mjs` 口径，含 `.github/` 等仓库文件），其中 `knowledge/` 的 592 篇原文 + 3924 个资产文件占绝大部分——**这是设计如此，不要"优化"掉**。

仓库地址已填为 `https://github.com/xuzhecomeon/dsh-research-suite`（`package.json` 的 `repository.url` / `homepage` / `bugs.url` 与两个 README 的徽章同步）。

以后换账号时，改 `package.json` 的 `repository`/`homepage`/`bugs` 与两个 README 的徽章后自查：`Select-String -Path package.json,README.md,README.zh-CN.md -Pattern "your-org"`，零命中才算干净。

- **不联网**：运行时只依赖 node 内置模块，不请求任何远程服务。
- **不读外部技能目录**：592 篇原文与 3924 个自带资产随包分发，不碰用户机器的其它技能库。
- **不写用户文件**：7 个工具都是只读查询、展开与机械自检。
- **入口不 import `@deepseek-ai/*`**：profile 的 `node_modules` 里解析不到这类包，入口一旦 import 就会整个加载失败（现象是"装了但一个技能都没有"）。这条由 `scripts/verify-package.mjs` 强制拦截。
